topic: how Warner Bros. Discovery posted a huge net loss mostly because of one accounting writedown
storyAngle: Most of the giant loss was an accounting charge for cable networks, not cash walking out the door.
doNotClaim: The $9.1 billion is a pre-tax, NON-CASH goodwill impairment charge in the Networks unit; never call it cash lost or money spent.
Do not say the company is failing or in trouble.
Do not say anything about streaming profit or loss.

facts.claim: Warner Bros. Discovery 2024 net loss was about $11.3 billion.
facts.note: one detailed source plus coverage agree; confirm in 10-K

facts.claim: In 2024 Warner Bros. Discovery recorded a pre-tax, non-cash goodwill impairment charge of $9.1 billion in its Networks business, because the carrying value exceeded fair value.
Warner Bros. Discovery 2024 revenues were about $39.3 billion.
say: thirty nine point three billion dollars

derived.claim: The impairment was about 81% of the net loss (9.1 / 11.3): roughly four fifths.
